profile.headline: Technical Customer Success Manager | Implementation & Client Success Professional | MBA | Software Engineering Graduate
profile.summary:
As a Customer Success and Operations professional with experience spanning financial services, SaaS, higher education, and software engineering, I help organizations build lasting customer partnerships that drive adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes.

Throughout my career, I have managed enterprise client relationships, guided customers through complex transitions, and partnered with stakeholders to solve business challenges. At Charles Schwab, I maintained a 100% client retention rate while supporting advisor firms representing $500K–$4B in assets under management and helping clients navigate the TD Ameritrade integration. At ADP, I managed mid-market organizations through payroll tax and compliance cycles, ensuring accuracy, accountability, and timely execution.

To strengthen my technical expertise, I recently completed a Full Stack Software Engineering program where I designed, tested, documented, and deployed applications utilizing Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment technologies. This experience enhanced my ability to collaborate with technical teams, understand software implementation challenges, and translate complex concepts into meaningful business outcomes.

I am particularly passionate about roles that bridge business and technology, including Technical Customer Success, Implementation Management, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Consulting.

Core Strengths:
Customer Success • Client Retention • Customer Onboarding • Implementation Management • Technical Account Management • Executive Stakeholder Management • Change Management • Customer Adoption • SaaS & FinTech Solutions • Cross-Functional Collaboration • Process Improvement • API Documentation • Technical Communication • Business Operations

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
Completed a Full Stack Software Engineering program focused on application development, API design, testing, documentation, and deployment.

Developed front-end and back-end applications utilizing Python, Flask, JavaScript, React, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, HTML, and CSS.

Designed and deployed RESTful APIs featuring authentication, authorization, Swagger documentation, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment.

Utilized GitHub, GitHub Actions, Postman, and Agile development methodologies throughout project lifecycles.

positions.title: Enhanced Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed a portfolio of 10–15 advisor firm relationships representing assets under management ranging from $500K to $4B while maintaining a 100% client retention rate through proactive relationship management and issue resolution.
• Selected for promotion from a general advisor services team to a dedicated institutional service group supporting higher-value advisor relationships and complex service needs.
• Served as the primary escalation point for high-value advisor firms, resolving service issues, retention risks, and complex client concerns.
• Supported advisor firms through the TD Ameritrade integration by providing onboarding guidance, change management support, and proactive communication during a large-scale organizational transition.
• Acted as the team Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Cost Basis inquiries, providing guidance and issue resolution support to peers and cross-functional teams.
• Managed overflow service requests during the TD Ameritrade transition, assisting advisors with platform adoption, process changes, and service escalations.
• Earned multiple Exceeds Expectations performance ratings and was recognized for strong client retention, problem-solving, and customer advocacy.
positions.insights: Process Optimization, FinTech Solutions and +16 skills

positions.title: Full Level Tax Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed a portfolio of 18–31 client organizations ranging from 50 to 1,000 employees, ensuring accurate payroll tax reconciliation and W-2 reporting.
• Successfully managed 10+ quarterly compliance cycles while consistently meeting regulatory filing deadlines and client reporting requirements.
• Developed and maintained Excel-based tracking systems to monitor required client documentation, manage follow-up activities, and support timely account reconciliation.
• Built trusted client relationships through proactive communication and ongoing document collection efforts to ensure compliance and reporting accuracy.
• Navigated complex payroll tax and compliance issues with limited formal training, demonstrating strong self-directed learning, problem-solving, and accountability.
positions.insights: Process Optimization, FinTech Solutions and +16 skills

positions.title: Adjunct Faculty Instructor
positions.description:
Developed and taught courses including ENT 201, ENT 203, ENT 252, MGT 251, MKT 221, and MKT 385 at Wilkes University in Mesa, Arizona.

Designed curriculum to engage students in understanding the nature of entrepreneurship, opportunity identification, and consumer behavior.

Implemented innovative teaching methods to enhance student learning and foster critical thinking skills.
positions.insights: Strategic Partnerships, Customer Experience and +8 skills

positions.title: Assistant to the Chair of the Business Programs of Arizona
positions.description:
Managed daily operations and organized executive schedules.

Coordinated student services functions, managed administrative operations, and supervised student employment.

Instructed and advised the undergraduate Entrepreneurship students, and facilitated the Mesa Financial Aid process.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was a board member of the Lake Pleasant Sailing club for 3 years and assisted in building their membership, developing sailing cruises, and overall Lake Pleasant Environment.
